title: Air-Fryer Chicken Thighs
subtitle: Crispy skin-on chicken thighs in the air fryer
excerpt: Bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs rubbed with smoked paprika and garlic powder, cooked in the air fryer until the skin is shatteringly crisp and the meat is juicy through to the bone.

recipe.sourceNotes: The air fryer is particularly well suited to bone-in chicken thighs because the circulating hot air renders the fat from the skin quickly and crisps it without the need for any extra oil. The dark meat of the thigh stays moist during the cooking time. Pat the skin completely dry before rubbing with the spice mix: any moisture will steam rather than crisp the skin.

content.text: Pat the skin completely dry with kitchen paper before seasoning. Wet skin steams instead of crisping. Cook the thighs skin-side up and do not flip partway through: the circulating air reaches all sides. Check the internal temperature at the thickest part, away from the bone: 75 C is safe.
Preheat the air fryer to 200 C for 3 minutes. Pat the chicken thighs completely dry with kitchen paper.

Mix the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper together. Rub the chicken thighs all over with the olive oil, then coat with the spice mix, getting it under the skin where possible.

Place the thighs skin-side up in the air fryer basket. Do not overlap. Cook at 200 C for 22 to 25 minutes until the skin is deep golden and crisp. The juices should run clear when the thickest part is pierced.
